title: Compatibility verification harness and cohort activation playbook for Private/VPC deployments
creator: Asha Patel
description: Build an automated compatibility verification harness plus a gated cohort activation playbook to reduce upgrade risk for Private/VPC/on-prem customers. This ticket scopes the PM work to define acceptance criteria, rollout cohorts, observability gates, and required integrations with Console, Dedicated orchestration, and Eng runbooks. The goal is to provide an executable playbook and an initial automation prototype that allows us to safely activate platform upgrades for customers with minimal manual steps and measurable safety gates.
acceptance_criteria: A prototype compatibility harness that runs a configurable permutation matrix (runtime version x model quantization x network topology) on a test tenant and produces pass/fail signals

Console gating integration: a pass/fail dashboard that surfaces cohort-level signals (error rate, 99th latency, token cost delta, generation quality regressions) with automated approval/hold recommendations
Cohort activation playbook documented and validated with SRE and Solutions Engineering, covering alpha->beta->general cohorts and explicit rollback triggers
Two pilot customers activated through the playbook with zero critical incidents and less than 1% customer-facing error increase over baseline during 7-day post-activation window
Runbook automation for preflight checks (KMS access, SSO connectivity, namespace quotas) implemented as executable scripts in repo and referenced in playbook

risks: Signal noise: false positives from model eval regressions leading to unnecessary rollbacks
Customer infra variability: on-prem networking or proxy behaviors not reproducible in central testbeds
Automation gaps: preflight checks miss a permission edge-case (KMS token rotation)
Resource constraints: Dedicated capacity for cohort testing may conflict with customer traffic demands
rollout_steps: Create compatibility matrix template and companion harness runner (repo: redwood/private-compat-runner)
Instrument Console to ingest harness outputs and synthesize per-cohort pass/fail signals
Define three activation cohorts: alpha (internal), beta (select customers), broad (opt-in expansion)
Execute preflight checks (KMS, SSO, quota, model version pinning) via automated scripts
Run harness permutations for each cohort; require 3 consecutive successful runs before moving to next cohort
Activate build for beta cohort with monitoring and a 24/7 on-call window for first 72 hours
Perform post-activation quality evaluation (sampled prompts + eval suite) and cost delta analysis
If metrics exceed thresholds, execute automated rollback and run root-cause workflow
metrics: Post-activation customer-facing error rate delta <= +1% vs baseline
Token-cost delta impact <= +3% for typical workloads
Time to detect failure (Console alert to on-call ack) <= 10 minutes
notes: This ticket is intentionally product-focused and assumes ENG will split implementation tasks into per-service tickets (runtime adapters, console integration, QA harness)
Consider adding a small dedicated test fleet that mirrors common customer topologies for higher-fidelity runs
We should store harness permutations and results as structured artifacts to allow post-hoc evals and reproducibility
Coordinate with Security to include a KMS rotation test in preflight; include check for HSM latency implications
